primary.title: PRIM vs mutual funds vs PMS: Experts explain how they differ on portfolio structure, costs, taxation and suitability
primary.summary: SEBI’s new PMS framework introduces PRIM, allowing investors to access professionally managed portfolios of mutual funds, ETFs and SIFs. Here's how PRIM compares with conventional PMS and mutual funds on investment, management, taxation and flexibility.
